entries.claim: On its current pricing page (fresh re-capture 2026-07-12) Jasper lists a two-tier public ladder: Pro at $69/month per seat ($59/month per seat billed annually, including 1 seat), and Business at custom pricing. The Pro tier's 'Smart customization' is capped at '2 Brand Voices, 5 Knowledge assets and 3 Audiences' (unlimited only on custom-priced Business), and includes Canvas, marketing Agents, image generation, a plagiarism checker, browser extension and 7-day history/backups. A 7-day free trial is offered; the pricing page states no money-back window, and cancellation stops future charges with access through the end of the billing cycle. Vendor-stated, self-interested.
